[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Crescent History and the Charter[/color][/head]
Crescent was settled in overlapping waves. Imperial marcher charters, independent noble ventures, merchant colonies, worker settlements, and corporate concessions all claimed pieces of the same frontier. Extraction created wealth quickly and pushed losses downward through noble dues, company debt, guild obligations, freight charges, and military levies.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]The First Turning[/color][/head]
During the extraction boom, stripped fields regained seams and exposed installations returned in mixtures of old and new states. Once operators learned that material removed from a recurrence basin persisted, Taypan became a renewable extraction frontier. Mining, insurance, Anchor Vaults, phase research, shipbuilding, and armed convoy work expanded around it.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]The Workers' Rising[/color][/head]
The modern revolution began on independent Vaucelles, whose Aurevienne feudal order tied industrial privilege, debt, housing, and policing together. Kane and the Chengridz undercity organized before outside help arrived. The Workers' Union professionalized an existing revolt with officers, weapons, intelligence, and support. After victory, Vaucelles became [bold]Chengridz[/bold], secure Workers' Union territory. The NCWL is the provisional front carrying that revolution across contested Crescent.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]The company federation and the Minutemen[/color][/head]
Gorlex, Interdyne, Cyberdawn, and SAW formed the Taypani Free Companies Federation to resist dependence on Shinohara's finance, yards, standards, and supply chains. They remain distinct organizations under a jointly selected Administrator for Federation matters.
The Colonial Minutemen began as publicly funded route and settlement defense. They broke with the Mandate rather than enforce foreign claims over local law. Imperial forces destroyed their mobile headquarters, Analiesse; survivors carried Minutemen law and professional culture to Gliess Santo.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Count Olywier's charter[/color][/head]
Count Olywier Rabenau remains Warden of Crescent's principal Imperial charter. His authority is contractual: he governs holdings, collects defined dues, grants subordinate privileges, and maintains local forces in exchange for Crown tax, resources, military service, and loyalty. Asterwald and its capital, Edelheim, form his stable administrative rear.
The Lord Admiral is Olywier's senior frontier military officer, selected by local nobility and confirmed by the Count. The Imperial Adjutant is the Crown Overseer: an independent observer and diplomatic liaison who reports to Domain, not a second commander in the local chain of command.
